title: Amazon Bedrock Long-term API key (ABSK): one-property twin (boundary)
summary: 1 input is identical to a positive input except for one change: the value is cut, extended or delimited so that it no longer ends where the format ends. Legacy mutation notes: boundary: one Base64 character before ABSK, so the key is embedded in a longer run. Twin of "Amazon Bedrock Long-term API key (ABSK): must be flagged".
rationale: A twin changes exactly one property, so the expected outcome differs from the positive for that one reason. Reporting the twin is a false alarm, and it shows that the changed property is part of what identifies the credential.

expectation.rationale: Negative twin of aws-bedrock-long-term-api-key-openai-sdk: boundary: one Base64 character before ABSK, so the key is embedded in a longer run. Exactly one structural property differs from the positive; silence follows from construction.
